name: Class G Permit (Specific Trade, Business or Consultancy)

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum of US$100,000 in documented capital investment.
requirements.fix_path: Invest at least US$100,000 in the trade, business, or consultancy.

requirements.blocker_text: Valid Tax Compliance Certificate required (both company and individual on renewal).

evidence_required.document: Company registration documents and PIN certificate
Audited accounts for the previous 2 years (renewals)

outcome.duration_length: annual, renewable (KShs 250,000/year issuance fee implies yearly cycle)

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services, Republic of Kenya -- Class G Permit (Specific Trade, Business or Consultancy): minimum US$100,000 documented capital investment; processing fee KShs 20,000 (non-refundable), issuance fee KShs 250,000/year, gratis for EAC member-state nationals; requires company registration, PIN certificate, shareholders certificate (CR12), audited accounts (renewals)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Directorate of Immigration Services). Family can join is set true per the general Dependant's Pass mechanism (see ke_family_reunification.json), which explicitly covers dependents of work-permit holders including Class G holders. work_rights set to 'restricted' since the permit is tied to the specific declared trade/business, not an open labour-market right.
